events.name: Bash
events.head: Find free month references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn -i "free_month\|freeMonth\|free-month\|month is on us\|first month" app/src cloud/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v test | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find free month references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn -i -E "free_month|freeMonth|free-month|on us|first month" app/src cloud/src | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find free month code references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn -o -E ".{80}(free_month|freeMonth|data-free-month).{80}" app/src/app app/src/lib cloud/src | grep -v generated | cut -c1-260 | head -30

events.text: Checking where the free-month copy and badge render, then I'll extend and run the probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find copy and badge for free month
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i -E "on us|free month|month of (Tantra|Pro)" app/src/app/onboarding/centre/*.tsx app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts app/src/lib/card-education.ts app/src/lib/prompt-pack.ts | cut -c1-300 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for badge and d2-channels card
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -E 'seat === "vip"|badge' app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx | head; grep -n '"d2-channels"' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -3
